definitions.gloss: being caught between; stuck in the middle; dilemma
definitions.explanation: A situation where one is trapped between two opposing forces, expectations, or choices, unable to satisfy both sides.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}と{部下|ぶか}の{板挟|いたばさ}みになった。
examples.english: I got caught between my boss and my subordinates.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}と{家庭|かてい}の{板挟|いたばさ}みで{苦|くる}しんでいる。
examples.english: I'm struggling, caught between work and family.

examples.japanese: {親友|しんゆう}たちの{喧嘩|けんか}で{板挟|いたばさ}みの{状態|じょうたい}だ。
examples.english: I'm stuck in the middle because of my best friends' fight.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{板|いた} (board) + {挟|はさ}み (being sandwiched) - literally being squeezed between two boards, expressing the feeling of being trapped.

USAGE:
Commonly describes:
・Being between two people in conflict
・Conflicting obligations (work vs. family)
・Difficult decisions with no good options

COLLOCATIONS:
・{板挟|いたばさ}みになる - to get caught between
・{板挟|いたばさ}みの{状態|じょうたい} - a state of being caught between
・AとBの{板挟|いたばさ}み - caught between A and B

RELATED:
・{八方塞|はっぽうふさ}がり - blocked in all directions
